evidence: Cached instruction bytes decoded as data and source files manually reviewed/edited only; no project/game loading, builds, tests, syntax checks, GPU/API execution, process inspection or Bedrock operations

nativeFacts.contextFenceCheck: 0xdfa167d compares context+2cbd0 with the requested fence
nativeFacts.usedPop: 0xdfa16b3 through 0xdfa16e2 updates the inclusive used ring and empty sentinel
nativeFacts.freePush: 0xdfa1913 through 0xdfa1996 transfers completed contexts into the free ring
nativeFacts.fenceRemovedCheck: 0xdfa19ad compares the native completed value with UINT64_MAX
nativeFacts.existingContract: The pinned native queue observer requires stable queue/fence/context/list identities, completed native fence, used-to-free membership and now a drained deferred-vector header with unchanged backing storage; the inspected native allocation route resets allocator/list before subsequent recording/execution
nativeFacts.deferredRelease: dfa1630..dfa1637 resets context+2cbe8 to +2cbe0 after copying deferred pointers to a temporary vector. dfa18e9..dfa18f8 invokes their Release slots before the free-ring push. Detailed static evidence and its limits are in native-fence-retirement-source.json

sourcePort.registration: Unsafe retain_recording API transfers an opaque asset owner before any inserted command; caller must provide a live engine-owned direct recording list, serialize recording/reset/execute and pin every referenced resource/descriptor/pipeline
sourcePort.registrationFailure: Returns assets with the error rather than destroying arbitrary payloads inside caller observer locks
sourcePort.identity: Public Execute and Reset use canonical IUnknown identity; the actual intercepted graphics-list pointer is retained only as a numeric alias for the native context join; the pool holds no owning command-list reference
sourcePort.submission: depth_tracker's existing submission gate encloses owner reservation, actual ExecuteCommandLists and per-owner private fence signals; monotonic submission ordinals revalidate generation/queue identity
sourcePort.replayability: Private GPU fence completion alone cannot retire a still-replayable closed native list
sourcePort.reset: Successful public Reset marks the old list generation non-replayable without assuming GPU completion
sourcePort.destruction: Release candidates are atomically captured before the actual Release, with no post-destruction object access; a zero return records only the captured generations
sourcePort.nativeHandoff: depth_queue used-to-free validation carries separate draw-asset tickets; same owner generation, canonical list, actual queue and submission ordinal must survive before replayability can be removed. Both snapshot and draw-asset tickets now also require stable before/after deferred-resource vector metadata, unchanged begin/capacity and drained end==begin; unreadable/changed/nonempty headers leave owners pinned
sourcePort.collection: The DX12 frame callback collects outside tracker/submission/pool locks; release requires non-replayability and the last private fence completion, or actual device removal; payload destructors run after the pool lock is released
sourcePort.uncertainty: Failed signals, cross-queue execution, poisoned submission gates, unresolved COM identity, excessive list arrays and counter exhaustion do not authorize early asset release
sourcePort.bounds: At most 16 opaque payloads; no timeout, sleeping worker, polling thread or unsafe eviction; submission array normalization is capped at 4096 lists
sourcePort.diagnostics: Bounded owner/replayable/failed/pending/retired counters and a separate native asset-handoff count, without object addresses

limitations: native_avatar_record now invokes retain_recording in its source transaction, but no game-facing insertion caller invokes that transaction; live inserted draws remain unfinished
An unrecognized final COM interface alias can conservatively leave an owner pinned until native retirement/reset or device removal
Failed or uncertain submissions can occupy bounded slots until device removal; memory safety is not inferred from elapsed time
The registration contract still requires actual native target/world/material ownership and complete graphics-state restoration from its future caller
Live native lighting/feature-group inputs, default/deferred targets, native drawing, camera/video comparisons and full feature parity remain unfinished
